summary: The same world as a-running-process-is-not-a-serving-one, driven through the real orchestrator, event log, Effect Ledger, and Run Bundle. One Run on one idle Rental that holds the image assembled, a container runtime that hands back a process twenty seconds in, and an application behind it that never reports it can do work. What this holds at L1 that the placement corpus cannot is the calibration record. The launch's consequence carries a duration for the seven stages it reached and none for the eighth, and it says so: application_becomes_ready is false, so the readiness row reads launch_never_reached_stage rather than a measured zero, and safety.prediction_is_recorded_against_its_actual holds without a readiness actual because a stage that never happened has nothing to measure. Both other readings of that missing number are wrong in opposite directions, and the world is the only thing that can say which one this is.
